consumer: The monster-awareness/AI perception predicate that EVALUATES, per monster, the yes/no question 'can this monster see the avatar right now?' to set the 'noticed' flag.
scope: A directed pairwise visibility predicate from each monster to the avatar across all relevant monsters (monster->avatar perception), not merely monsters inside the render/export window.
decisive_source: src/creature.cpp::Creature::sees — its body computes the boolean 'can this creature see that critter now' from range, light, line of sight, and concealment; that returned value is the authority for 'noticed', not a re-derivation from exported position/hp.
divergence: A monster one tile from the avatar but with a wall between them (or in darkness): Creature::sees returns false so it has NOT noticed the avatar, yet a window/distance re-derivation from the exported monster list would wrongly flag it as having noticed.
